messages:
lena: Quick sync request — we need to land the runtime/infra contract for per-route SLO dashboards. goal: P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT, and tokens/sec by model+route. Who owns the ingest changes?
aj: I can take ownership of the telemetry pipeline changes, but need the exact field list and cardinality constraints.
devon: From runtime: we can emit the extra labels, but we want a clear whitelist. adding free-form tags will explode cardinality.
lena: Agreed. Suggested labels: `route`, `model_name`, `model_variant`, `region`, `priority_tier`. Do NOT include commit hashes.
samir: Ok for prometheus/histogram compatibility: emit `request_latency_ms` as histogram buckets and `ttft_ms` as summary (or histogram if we want percentiles server-side). tokens/sec as gauge measured every 1s or derived from counters?
aj: prefer counters + recording rule to get tokens/sec: `tokens_processed_total{route,model}` then rate() -> less cardinality stress.
devon: Confirming runtime can emit `tokens_processed_total` and `request_duration_ms_bucket` for histograms. We'll need an env flag to enable per-route labels for low-card routes only.
harper: Console needs template vars: route and model. Panels should support selecting model variants and comparing P95 across variants. Also need sampling notes for when route has low qps.
lena: Ownership: aj = telemetry pipeline + sampling, devon = runtime emit, samir = ingest schema + prometheus rules, harper = dashboard UI + templating.
aj: For sample rate, propose default ingest of 100% for production tier routes with qps > 5, otherwise 10% with scaling. We'll tag sampled=true label when sampled so downstream can correct counts.
samir: If we add `sampled=true`, downstream queries must divide by sample rate — risky for dashboards. Alternative: pipeline can extrapolate and write adjusted metrics for dashboards.
devon: runtime can tag `sampler_version` but not do extrapolation. pipeline doing extrapolation makes sense.
harper: Dashboard UX: show a small warning when sampling active: "Metric values have sampling applied — confidence lower." Also link to detail modal with sample rate and window.
aj: On retention and cost: prometheus long-term storage will balloon if we include model_variant for millions of variants. Need policy: variants only for verified/production models; others set variant="untracked".
lena: Good. Also we need SLO definitions per route documented in a central repo. harper, can console link to SLO docs?
harper: yes — a panel footer link to infra docs and the SLO YAML.
samir: Quick draft metric names and types:
```
# counters
redwood.tokens_processed_total{route,model_name,model_variant,region}
# histograms
redwood.request_duration_ms_bucket{route,model_name,region,le}
# summary or histogram for TTFT
redwood.ttft_ms_bucket{route,model_name,region,le}
# derived
tokens_per_sec = rate(redwood.tokens_processed_total[1m])
P95 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood.request_duration_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model_name))
```

aj: Looks good. We should add a `routing_policy` label (e.g., `routing_policy=latency|cost|fallback`) so dashboard can slice by policy.
devon: runtime can emit `routing_policy` for request logs; exposing in metrics will require propagation through fronting proxies. We'll coordinate with ingress team.
lena: Action items: 1) devon: runtime PR to add metrics + labels (due EOD Thu). 2) aj: telemetry pipeline spec for sampling/extrapolation + cardinality rules (due Mon). 3) samir: prometheus recording rules and long-term retention impact analysis (due Mon). 4) harper: dashboard wireframes + sample panels (due Tue).
telemetry-bot: Created tracking ticket INF-4829 for "per-route SLO metrics and dashboard onboarding" and linked this thread.
aj: one more Q — rollouts. we want canary dashboards in staging. samir, do we have a staging prometheus with same retention?
samir: yes but reduced retention. we'll mirror recording rules. We'll use `env=staging` label and then copy to prod rules once validated.
lena: sweet. if no blockers, I'll post to eng-all for FYI and then loop in ingress. :thumbsup:
